mcqs.question: After the launch of NVS-01, which five satellites provided positioning services through NavIC?
options: IRNSS-1B, IRNSS-1C, IRNSS-1F, IRNSS-1I and NVS-01
IRNSS-1A, IRNSS-1B, IRNSS-1G, IRNSS-1I and NVS-01
IRNSS-1B, IRNSS-1D, IRNSS-1F, IRNSS-1H and NVS-02
IRNSS-1C, IRNSS-1E, IRNSS-1F, IRNSS-1I and NVS-02
mcqs.explanation: The five satellites providing positioning after NVS-01 were IRNSS-1B, IRNSS-1C, IRNSS-1F, IRNSS-1I and NVS-01. The other options replace one or more of these satellites with entries not included in this five-satellite set.

mcqs.question: With reference to the NVS-02 mission, identify the incorrect statement.
options: NVS-02 was launched in January 2025 by GSLV-F15.
NVS-02 failed to reach its final orbit because the signal did not reach the pyro valve of the oxidiser line.
NVS-02 failed to reach its final orbit because its heat shield did not open.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that NVS-02 failed because its heat shield did not open. The reported problem was that the signal did not reach the pyro valve of the oxidiser line, following connector disengagement; NVS-02 was launched in January 2025 by GSLV-F15 as ISRO's 100th launch.
